data.name: Space Inflation
data.detailed_description:
Engage in a galactic struggle for economic survival!

Step into a universe where wealth is power and strategy decides who thrives and who falls. In this card-driven game, every decision matters. Will you build your fortune through careful planning, or tear down your rivals with ruthless sabotage? The galaxy rewards only the clever.

Strategic Card Play
Outsmart your opponents by managing your deck wisely. Each card you play can shift the balance of power, whether it undermines another player, or unlocks new opportunities. Timing and foresight are key, one well-played card can change the course of the game.

Mini-Games That Test Your Skill
It’s not just about strategy, it’s about proving yourself in unique mini-games. Sharpen your reflexes and logic as you battle through challenges that can earn you advantages.

Survival of the Wealthiest
The endgame is simple: only the last two players with credits left will claim victory. Every round brings new tension as inflation rises. Can you hold out while others crumble?

Features at a Glance

  • Multiplayer matches with friends and rivals.

  • Card-driven mechanics.

  • Mini-games.

  • A unique blend of economic survival and player interaction.

Do you have what it takes to survive the galaxy’s unforgiving economy? Gather your cards, outthink your enemies, and fight for your fortune!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit version only)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 or AMD Ryzen 3 2200G
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 2000 graphics or Vega 8 graphics
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or better (64bit version only)
  • Processor: NVIDIA GeForce 8800 GT (512 MB) or ATI Radeon HD 4850 (512 MB) or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card with DX11 or OpenGL 3.x capabilities
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
